findings.summary: Data lineage is dropped because derive-mvp-features.ts manually overrides provenance with empty sourceRefs and rawObservationRefs instead of using the ones assembled by assembleDerivedFeature.
findings.suggested_fix: Spread the assembled result into the returned insert object instead of manually building provenance with empty arrays.

findings.summary: Fake NormalizedObservationRow objects created from CandidateRejections corrupt the payloadHash by injecting incorrect rawObservationIds and dummy payloads into assembleAvailableFeature.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass actual NormalizedObservationRow objects for rejected rows instead of mapping CandidateRejections with copied properties.
